description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class for filtering search parameters related to timesheet action logs within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields and default sort field.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating filter parameters for searching timesheet action logs, with predefined allowed sort fields and default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter DTO by setting the default sort field to 'timesheetActionLog.date'.
